Technological convergence directly implicates OEM strategies, prioritizing compatibility across hardware categories and reflecting an increasing adoption of integrated systems and digital innovation processes. However, suppliers and OEMs alike must continuously balance the development of bespoke proprietary systems with these emerging industry-wide synchronization pathways to maintain both competitive differentiation and broad market appeal. While compatibility advancements primarily cater to operational efficiency, the ability to directly source high-performing mining tools exemplifies how OEMs have successfully optimized customer access channels to industrial-scale technology [45] .
